method: Independent model linguistic review of all 100 proposed selected English lexical templates and all 392 exact source combined-form senses, not automatic agreement from source presence or first-author judgment. Each approval binds the exact source verb record and zero-based selected meaning; absent transitive tags were assessed semantically. Only selected inanimate single-accusative lo/la/los/las readings with explicit infinitive or positive imperative grammar are approved. These are original selected word-level English renderings, not dictionary-provided full translations, example sentences, universal coverage or native-human/Mexican certification. Retain lexical context, regional/register labels and source object/subject morphology. Mixed transitive/reflexive lexical inventories do not turn the selected explicit accusative form into an active reflexive construction. No suffix/accent decomposition, se/recipient/personal/dative composition, multi-clitic, negative, finite indicative, unsupported argument, extra destination or qualified English past/participle override is authorized. Record indices flatten proposal order then nested record order; source sense indices and CREAR/CREER homographs remain independent. Voseo is explicitly labelled.
